name: vwap_rsi_volume_hybrid_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-agent-4
thesis: Intraday price tends to revert toward VWAP, but naked VWAP mean-reversion suffers from high false-positive rates. Adding RSI as an oversold/overbought filter and requiring abnormal volume (>1.5x 20-bar average) as confirmation materially improves hit rate. The inefficiency persists because most retail participants trade VWAP or RSI in isolation, and the triple-confirmation window is narrow enough (typically <5 minutes per day per stock) that institutional algos focused on larger time-scales ignore it. The edge is further protected by restricting to mid-cap names (NIFTY Next 50) where algo coverage is thinner than in NIFTY 50.
mechanism: Short-term selling exhausts available demand at a price level, creating a temporary liquidity vacuum. Market makers who absorbed the selling begin marking prices back to reduce inventory risk. Limit buy orders resting below create a floor, and new participants entering the long side accelerate the reversion as the forced selling pressure dissipates.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 25; if VIX > 20, halve position size
filters.volume_filter: Skip if stock 5-min volume < 50% of 20-day average for that 5-min bucket

weaknesses: Triple confirmation is restrictive — may generate only 1-2 signals per day across entire universe, leading to significant opportunity cost
RSI(14) on 1-min bars is noisy and can whipsaw rapidly; 14-bar lookback on 1-min data captures only 14 minutes of price action
VWAP mean-reversion breaks down on strong trend days (e.g., post-RBI policy, budget days) where price can stay 100+ bps from VWAP for hours
prior_art: Berkowitz et al. (2005) on VWAP execution; Connors & Alvarez RSI(2) mean-reversion; various retail strategies combining VWAP+RSI on TradingView
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
